note: Side A (yctimlin mcp-excalidraw-server 2.0.0). By-eye manifest of final-own.png, checked against sidecar.png (render.js --paint --drop-index). The final is clean: every node over its cell, path 8-12-10-11 highlighted in nodes and edges, lo/hi at indices 8 and 11, caption present. Listed defects are session incidents (fixedInFinal true) and export faults that do not show in final-own.png.

defects.ruleGap: free text textAlign center rendered left-aligned
defects.description: Index labels sent as 56 px wide centred text were stored centred but drawn left-aligned in shot1 (the same stored-vs-rendered fault elkdraw fixed in 1.20).

defects.ruleGap: label in a transparent-stroke container is invisible
defects.description: Workaround: each index label as the label of a transparent rectangle. All 17 labels (0-14, lo, hi) took the container's transparent strokeColor and vanished in shot2; no warning.

defects.ruleGap: text-wrapped: two-digit keys in 44 px circles
defects.description: Keys 12 and 10 wrapped to two lines in shot1 (labels paint at Excalifont 20 whatever fontSize the shape asked for); fixed by growing the circles to 52 px.

unmapped.description: The export records endArrowhead "arrow" on the 14 tree edges the tester sent with endArrowhead null (final-own.png shows plain lines), roundness type 3 on rectangles drawn sharp, and fractional indices such as "a10" and "a80" that Excalidraw rejects ("invalid order key"; render.js needs --drop-index). sidecar.png therefore shows arrowheads and rounded cells that the tester's canvas does not.
unmapped.source: scene.excalidraw vs final-own.png; transcript tool inputs
unmapped.reason: yctimlin export is not the painted scene; no lint rule depends on it here
